responsibility: Defines the compile-time data model for COBOL INSPECT statements and declares the corresponding code-generation entry points. It represents INSPECT tallying and replacing clauses, match and replacement operands, BEFORE/AFTER qualifiers, and nested bound semantics such as CHARACTERS/ALL/LEADING/FIRST, providing the structured operand containers that parse.y fills before handing INSPECT operations to parser_inspect and parser_inspect_conv.
